title: The One Metric Cyclists Over 40 Need to Start Watching
content:
In your 20s and 30s, you could ride hard every day and recover overnight. But after 40 you need to start paying attention to a new metric if you want to avoid burnout and fatigue.

Read the full article at The One Metric Cyclists Over 40 Need to Start Watching on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
